# Moviefone

> > Moviefone is your comprehensive entertainment guide for discovering movies, TV shows, showtimes, streaming options, and entertainment news all in one place.

Moviefone serves as a central hub for movie and television entertainment, offering real-time showtimes, streaming availability across major platforms, curated recommendations, and exclusive celebrity content. The site aggregates data on theatrical releases, streaming charts, reviews, and trailers to help users find and watch their favorite entertainment.

## Key Topics

- Movie showtimes
- Streaming content
- Where to watch
- Movie discovery
- TV shows
- In-theaters
- Coming soon
- Movie reviews
- Entertainment news
- Movie trailers
- Celebrity interviews
- Box office
- Theater chains
- New releases
- Genre filtering

## Core Entertainment Discovery

- [Moviefone Homepage](https://www.moviefone.com): Main hub to find movies, TV shows, showtimes, reviews, and trailers
- [Movies](https://www.moviefone.com/movies): Browse movies by genre and popularity across theaters and streaming
- [TV Shows](https://www.moviefone.com/tv-shows): Browse TV shows by genre and popularity on streaming platforms
- [Streaming Movies & TV Shows](https://www.moviefone.com/streaming): Discover streaming content across services; find where to watch online
- [What to Watch on Streaming](https://www.moviefone.com/what-to-watch): Get streaming recommendations from Netflix, Prime Video, and other services

## Showtimes & Theatrical Releases

- [Find Movie Showtimes Near You](https://www.moviefone.com/showtimes): Search local theater showtimes by movie, date, and location
- [Movies in Theaters](https://www.moviefone.com/movies/in-theaters): Browse current theatrical releases with showtimes and box office rankings
- [Movies Coming Soon](https://www.moviefone.com/movies/coming-soon): Discover upcoming movie releases by genre with showtimes and tickets
- [Movie Theaters](https://www.moviefone.com/showtimes/theaters): Browse movie theaters including AMC, Regal, Cinemark, and iPic chains

## Charts & Trending Content

- [Movie Charts in United States](https://www.moviefone.com/streaming/movies/charts): Browse trending streaming movie charts across US, UK, Canada, Australia
- [Show Charts in United States](https://www.moviefone.com/streaming/tv-shows/charts): Browse trending TV show charts across multiple regions and genres
- [Movie and TV Highlights](https://www.moviefone.com/highlights): Explore featured movie and TV highlights with trending blockbusters

## Reviews, Videos & Trailers

- [Movie Reviews](https://www.moviefone.com/movies/reviews): Read latest movie reviews and ratings with critic scores aggregated
- [New Movie Trailers](https://www.moviefone.com/videos/movie-trailers): Watch new movie trailers, previews, and HD clips for upcoming releases
- [Moviefone Videos](https://www.moviefone.com/videos): Original Moviefone videos including interviews, trailers, and box office
- [Moviefone TV - Videos](https://www.moviefone.com/videos/moviefone-tv): Exclusive celebrity interviews and behind-the-scenes content from films

## Entertainment News & Celebrity

- [News](https://www.moviefone.com/news): Entertainment news covering movies, TV, celebrity updates, and releases
- [Popular Celebrities](https://www.moviefone.com/celebrity): Browse popular actors and celebrities with filmography and news
- [Made In Hollywood](https://www.moviefone.com/made-in-hollywood): Weekly series with celebrity interviews and behind-the-scenes Hollywood content
